altText: Schematic cannabis achene anatomy showing the outer pericarp fruit wall, true seed and thin seed coat, small residual peripheral endosperm, curved embryo with two cotyledons, radicle, hypocotyl region, plumule, and stylar end.
productionBrief: Academic botanical plate aligned to THC-ENC-007. Show the whole planted unit as an achene beside a longitudinal cutaway. Clearly separate the pericarp/fruit wall from the true seed and thin seed coat. Show a curved embryo occupying most of the true seed, two cotyledons, radicle, hypocotyl region, plumule/shoot region, stylar end, and only a small residual peripheral endosperm. Mark the drawing as schematic and do not imply universal scale. Do not show a cereal-like central endosperm, do not omit endosperm entirely, and do not label the pericarp as if it were only seed coat.
